fields.name: navLabel

fields.name: style
fields.label: Style
fields.description:
No Snap - If enabled, removes section from the scroll-snap animation.
Hide Scroll Indicator - hides the Scroll cue in this section's hero.
Article Hero - add an Image, Breadcrumb, Title and Article Info.
Article Body - the article content.
Primary V2 Buttons - every primary button in this section uses the Primary V2 look.
Collage - Add a Title, a Text and exactly 8 Images.
Image Gradient - darkens the bottom of every image and video in this section.
Wave In - when the page scrolls to this section, it rises over the previous one behind a soft wave edge.
Side Panel (popups) - on a page under /modals/: the popup opens as a full-height panel from the right instead of a centred card.
Product Page - a light (off-white) background with dark text; in it, Cards Carousel, Vertical Tabs, Accordion and Spec Table Showcase take their product page layout.
Statement - a short line shown very large across the screen, its words rising into place, e.g. between two sections: add only a Title (a few words) to the section.
Hide Header - scrolling down to this section slides the site header away; scrolling up brings it back.
Show Floater - shows the Floater on this section.

Short line 3. and on: the detail, shown with the image when the card is opened (a heading first is the detail title).

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Default is a standard columns layout. Thank You is a full-bleed split (image + centered content) on a dark surface. Reach Us is the Contact Us layout (use 3 columns × 2 rows): it also styles the Title above and the Text below it in the same section and adds a live IST clock. Split is two full-screen video panes side by side (2 columns): each column a link to an MP4, a heading, bold-first stat lines (e.g. **1100+ KM** range), a heading and text for its card; an optional 2nd row is a film card (image | eyebrow, line, MP4 link, then a heading and text for the film). Reach Us (Photo) is the Reach Us layout over a dark photo instead of the gradient: put an Image (and optionally a Text with a link to an MP4, for a muted looping film) alone in one cell, e.g. the empty first cell of the second row.

fields.description: Optional. Only used for a video on mobile. Uses the desktop thumbnail if empty.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Heading, text and buttons. Carousel: shown on every slide without its own Text (with Opening Animation, its first two paragraphs are the animation's lines). Tech Slides: shown below every slide; key and value paragraph pairs (e.g. Battery / 26.7 kWh) become stat tiles, then the button. Product, in this order: title (Heading 1), a link to the film's MP4 (its text is the card's eyebrow, e.g. Watch the film) and the card's text in the next paragraph, the price line (amount in bold), then the button. Dealer, in this order: the status line (e.g. Closed today · Opens Monday, 10am), the dealer's name (Heading 1), the address, the two buttons in one paragraph, then the product card's paragraphs: its title (e.g. [ New ] Combat), the price line and a line of text.

fields.name: manifesto
fields.label: Scroll Manifesto (Editorial and Intro)
fields.description: Editorial and Intro styles only. Appears on scroll.

fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Showcase only. Optional. A decorative layer behind the main image, e.g. a sky behind a cut-out car photo.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo (Product)
fields.description: Product only. The model's logo or lockup, shown above the title.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Hero layout. Carousel and Tech Slides take up to 3 slides. Product: a car launch hero with the logo and a big centred title, a Watch the film card and the price beside the button. Its Background Image is the whole scene (e.g. the car in its landscape); the Logo has its own field. Dealer: a dealer storefront hero with the status line, name, address and two buttons bottom left, and a product card (the Video Thumbnail and the paragraphs after the buttons) bottom right.

fields.name: classes_opening
fields.label: Opening Animation
fields.description: Carousel only. On load the first slide plays in a small card in the middle of the screen, then grows to fill it. The first two Text paragraphs appear either side of the card, and only there (screen readers still get them).

fields.name: classes_showroom
fields.label: Showroom Layout
fields.description: Carousel only. The Text stays beside every slide: its first paragraphs are the eyebrow above the slide's heading, and each paragraph that starts with a bold label (e.g. **Address** Plot 14, Sector 54) becomes a row of the info card under the slide's text. Each slide's own Text gives its heading and description.

fields.name: classes_thumbs-bottom
fields.label: Thumbnails at the Bottom
fields.description: Carousel only. Moves the thumbnails to a row at the bottom right and keeps the heading and text clear of them and of the Test Drive strip.

fields.name: classes_align
fields.label: Heading Position
fields.description: Where the heading sits: left, centre or right. Only the heading moves; the text and buttons stay where the style puts them. Default keeps the style's own layout.

fields.name: mobileThumbnail

Two Cover showcases in sections one after the other (e.g. Exterior and Interior) get a switch at the top between them: give each a View name.

fields.name: hotspots

fields.description: Up to 8 bullets, one per + point, written as: x, y | TITLE | description (title up to 40 characters, description up to 200). x and y are percentages of the image from its bottom-left corner, and the + is centred on that point. You can drag the + points to any position in preview mode. A maximum of 8 hotspots is allowed. Cover style: link a point's TITLE to its photo in AEM Assets and the photo shows in its detail panel; the photos linked on one colour are used for the other colours too.

The Decorative Image is the map beside it.

fields.name: show

fields.name: viewAll

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Combine freely, e.g. Vertical + Pills. Accordion on mobile stacks the tabs below 600px. Specs lays out a spec comparison: give each tab a Fragment holding a Columns block (one column per model; row 1 the model names, every other cell a label and a value as two paragraphs). Locations shows each tab as an image tile: give each tab a city Title and one image as its Content; the open tab's image fills the section. FAQ puts text tabs above the accordions of a Light FAQ section: give each tab a Title, then add one Accordion block per tab after the Tabs block in the same section (the first accordion goes in the first tab, and so on), or give a tab a Fragment holding an Accordion. Vertical in a Product Page section: 3 to 7 tabs; at most 7, no more can be added after the 7th.

fields.name: fragment
